zh.title: 雪梨機場推出50輛電動巴士
zh.summary: 雪梨機場宣布開始部署50輛電動巴士；朝2030年淨零目標邁進
body: 雪梨機場（Sydney Airport（SYD））宣布已開始部署一支50輛的電動巴士車隊，以取代其柴油動力車輛，這是該機場朝2030年實現範圍1與範圍2排放淨零目標邁出的一步。
這支新車隊由澳洲電動車製造商Bus & Coach International（BCI）供應，將逐步取代用於在機場陸側與空側區域載運乘客及員工的柴油巴士。
車隊由25輛雙操控空側停機坪巴士與25輛「Citirider」電動接駁巴士組成。每輛巴士將透過悉尼機場既有購電協議，以100%再生能源驅動。
機場也將在車上與公車站引入數位資訊顯示器，提供乘客即時的行車時間與等候時間估算。

en.title: Sydney Airport (SYD) rolls out 50 electric buses in push toward net zero by 2030
en.summary: Sydney Airport begins deploying 50 electric buses; step toward net zero 2030 goal
body: Sydney Airport (SYD) announced it has begun rolling out a fleet of 50 electric buses to replace its diesel-powered vehicles, marking a step toward its target of reaching net zero for Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 2030.

The new fleet, supplied by Australian electric vehicle manufacturer Bus & Coach International (BCI), will progressively replace diesel-powered buses used to transport passengers and staff across the airport’s landside and airside operations.

The fleet comprises 25 dual-control airfield apron buses and 25 "Citirider" electric shuttle buses. Each bus will be powered by 100% renewable energy through Sydney Airport’s existing power purchase agreement, directly reducing the airport’s Scope 1 emissions from ground operations.
Digital information displays will also be introduced onboard and at bus stops, giving passengers live estimates of travel time and wait times.

zh.title: 商用噴射機交易未來五年估近二千五百億美元
zh.summary: Global Jet Capital預測2026至2030年交易總額達2470億美元
body: 全球商務噴射機交易（含新機與二手機）預計在未來五年內接近2500億美元，此預測出自商務航空融資公司Global Jet Capital於2026年9月14日發布的第六年度《商務噴射機市場預測》。
根據其計量經濟模型，Global Jet Capital預估2026年至2030年底的總交易金額為2470億美元，期間平均年化成長率為4.1%。
該公司表示，各尺寸類別的商務噴射機交付量在此期間均將增加，其中重型噴射機需求成長最快。Global Jet Capital指出，買家偏好更大航程與容量，預估新手與二手重型噴射機的交易量分別成長3.3%與4.9%。
北美預期仍為最大商務噴射機市場，拉丁美洲第二，歐洲仍為新機的重要市場。

en.title: Business jet deals set to near quarter-trillion dollars over next five years, Global Jet Capital says
en.summary: Global Jet Capital projects $247B in transactions from 2026-2030; heavy jet growth fastest
body: Global business jet transactions, including both new and pre-owned aircraft, are set to approach a quarter of a trillion dollars over the next five years, according to Global Jet Capital, a business aviation finance firm.

The company released its 6th annual Business Jet Market Forecast on September 14, 2026. Using an econometric top-down model, it projects $247 billion in total transactions from 2026 through the end of 2030, with an average annualized growth rate of 4.1%.

Global Jet Capital stated that business jet deliveries across all size categories will increase during the period, with heavy jet demand rising at the fastest rate. Its outlook cites increasing order backlogs, resilient economic growth, and continued wealth creation as supporting factors.
North America is expected to remain the largest business jet market, with Latin America second and Europe remaining an important market for new aircraft.
